sights.n: ISAC Museum (Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures)
sights.address: University of Chicago campus, Hyde Park (per Wikipedia)
sights.w: The University of Chicago's free museum of the ancient Near East (ex-Oriental Institute) — a 40-ton Assyrian lamassu, Egyptian mummies, Persepolis reliefs.

sights.address: Washington Park community area, Chicago (per Wikipedia)
sights.w: Olmsted & Vaux's 372-acre South Side park, home of Lorado Taft's 'Fountain of Time' and the DuSable museum.

sights.address: Evanston lakefront, IL (per NPS NHL record)
sights.w: Château-style 1894 lakefront mansion of Nobel laureate and US Vice President Charles G. Dawes — a National Historic Landmark run by the Evanston History Center.
